card.name: Mixed spots in scandal and overdose text
card.fires_on: Mid-phrase words in news stories about spying, coups or cheating, and in overdose or absorption passages, such as the 'the' inside theophylline. The marked words are ordinary small words or word parts, not a single term.

modes.label: Spy and crime news
modes.description: Small words inside reports of searches, arrests or cheating rings.

modes.description: Partway through drug words in overdose and monitoring text.

card.writes: It seems to favor words for exposure or failure, like leaked, crashed and betrayed, and to disfavor neutral descriptive words.
card.plain: It fires on small in-between words in stories of spying, arrests or scandal, and in some overdose passages.
